# Outcome-driven routing

Follow [the editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md).

- Unclear audience or purpose: compass, only if clarifying changes the work.
- Unverified material factual claim: turing, scoped to the claim.
- Draft or targeted edit requested: caret.
- Voice, clarity or accusation concern: mark, echo or devil respectively.
- Useful visual requested: prism.
- Packaging requested: press, using the current canonical body.
- Outcome met or a decision is needed: stop and report.

A missing specialist file is not a failure. A present file is not clearance. Read reviewed_revision and scope. Mark stale reviews after every body edit. Record deliberately skipped checks as not-needed with a reason, not as passed reviews. Preserve existing canonical paths.
